# Code Review Templates (Playwright Code Review Agent)

The Playwright Code Review Agent uses two templates:
1. **Report:** `reports/code-review-<identifier>.md`
2. **PR review body:** posted to GitHub only after the human triage gate

Rules for both:
- Keep the headings in this order.
- Leave out empty finding groups.
- Never write "Approved", "PASS", or "LGTM". The final decision belongs to the human reviewer.

## 1. Report Template

~~~~markdown
# Code Review (AI First Pass) — <identifier>

**Date:** <YYYY-MM-DD>
**Reviewer:** Playwright Code Review Agent (first pass)
**Source:** <PR URL, or "Local branch: <branch> vs <target>">
**PR Title:** <title, or "N/A (local review)">
**Source Branch → Target Branch:** <source> → <target>
**Author:** <PR author or git user>
**Commits reviewed:** <first-sha>..<last-sha> (<n> commits)

**AI first-pass result:** No blocking findings / Needs work / Critical issues
**Human review status:** PENDING. Awaiting triage by <runner>, then final review by <reviewer(s)>.

---

## Summary

| Metric                    | Count |
| ------------------------- | ----- |
| Files reviewed            | N     |
| Files skipped (generated) | N     |
| ❌ Errors                 | N     |
| ⚠️ Warnings               | N     |
| ℹ️ Info                   | N     |
| 💡 Suggestions            | N     |
| 🧑 Needs human judgement  | N     |

## Automated Checks

| Check | Command | Result |
| ----- | ------- | ------ |
| Spec discovery and TS compile | `npx playwright test --list <changed specs>` | ✅ n tests / ❌ error |
| Cucumber step matching        | `npx cucumber-js feature/ --dry-run ...`     | ✅ / ❌ / skipped (no BDD changes) |
| JS syntax                     | `node --check <file>`                        | ✅ / ❌ |
| Committed artifacts           | `git diff --name-only` vs `.gitignore` rules | ✅ / ❌ |
| Secrets scan                  | pattern scan of added lines                  | ✅ / ❌ |
| Test execution                | only if the human allowed it at the gate     | not run / ✅ n passed / ❌ n failed |

## Changed Files

| File | Classification | Findings |
| ---- | -------------- | -------- |
| `tests/example.spec.js` | Playwright spec (JS) | ⚠️ 2 |
| `pageobjects/CartPage.js` | Page object (JS) | ✅ none |

## Findings

### `path/to/file.spec.js`

#### F-01 ❌ Error — Missing `await` on web-first assertion

**Lines:** 24 · **Category:** Async · **Confidence:** High · **In diff:** yes
**Block:** `test.describe('Checkout') › test('places an order')`
**Issue:** `expect(page.getByText('Thank you')).toBeVisible()` isn't awaited. The assertion never runs, so the test can pass while the page is broken.

**Suggested fix:**

```js
await expect(page.getByText('Thank you')).toBeVisible();
```

**Triage:** Pending   <!-- Confirmed / Dismissed: <reason> / Edited -->

## 🧑 Needs Human Judgement

- [ ] <item the agent couldn't verify, e.g. "Snapshot baseline landing-darwin.png changed: confirm visually">

## Positive Observations

- <what the change does well>

## Action Items (confirmed findings, by priority)

1. ❌ F-01 …
2. ⚠️ F-03 …

## Review Coverage

- Rules applied: Playwright Code Review Agent rule set, <agent version>
- Not covered by the AI: business correctness of expected values, test data validity against live environments, visual changes, anything outside the diff's files
~~~~

## 2. PR Review Body Template (event = COMMENT)

~~~~markdown
<!-- ai-code-review:first-pass -->
## 🤖 AI first-pass review. Human review required.

@<reviewer> please complete the review. This is an automated first look, not an approval.

**Result:** <No blocking findings / Needs work / Critical issues> · Files: N · ❌ N · ⚠️ N · 💡 N
**Triaged by:** @<runner> (<n> findings confirmed, <n> dismissed)

### Confirmed findings
| ID | Severity | File:Line | Issue |
| -- | -------- | --------- | ----- |
| F-01 | ❌ | `tests/checkout.spec.js:24` | Missing `await` on assertion |

Findings on changed lines are also posted as inline comments.

### 🧑 For the human reviewer to verify
- [ ] <needs-judgement item>
- [ ] Expected values match the requirement / ticket
- [ ] Tests pass locally or in CI (the AI did not run them)

<sub>Generated by the Playwright Code Review Agent. The final approve / request-changes decision belongs to the human reviewer.</sub>
~~~~
